Name: Willy Shop Overhaul
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
You ever wonder how Willy makes a living.
The inhabitants of the Valley don't seem to buy much in the store.
So I added more stuff for him to sell, very interesting and useful for the player.

Enter the store and see what's new yourself
Scroll down until you find it.



[b]I made some modifications to the Mod to fulfill some requests[/b]

Divided the Mod into parts and put the new items separated by their categories, so what you are not interested can be deleted and the mod will still work with the remaining parts [i](Just do not remove the folder [b]Overhaul[/b] It contains the base code of the mod)[/i]

[list=1]
[*]Removed the discount mechanics only on Android version it was conflicting with Price Drops and giving discounts in double

If you still want this mechanic on Android version of the game i recommend the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2047] Price Drops [/url]

Compatible with Android 1.4.5 and older versions of Stardew Valley

Made two versions of the mod Android and Standard
Download the version compatible with your game

Android for mobile
Standard for other versions

[/list]
[b]-> Installation <-[/b]

1- Download the desired mod directly from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] [b]This is the only site where I put my Mods [/b]
2- Move the zip file to your Stardew Valley's Mods folder
3- Extract the files in the Mods folder
4- Run the game with the SMAPI launcher
5- Be happy

[b]-> Uninstall <-[/b]

1- Delete the folder containing the Mod files that is located in your Stardew Valley's Mods folder
2- Go back on the  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] and leave a comment saying why you uninstalled the mod [s](Optional)[/s]
3- Too bad you don't want me anymore, but I'll get over it
4- Go ahead and have fun in Stardew Valley without me

[b]-> Update <-[/b]

1- Delete the folder containing the Mod files that is located in your Stardew Valley's Mods folder
2- Proceed with the installation of the update normally, follow from step 2 of the installation

[b]*Update note [/b]
[i]Do not replace or overwrite the files in the folder, this may cause errors
Delete first, and only then extract the new files from the update in the mods folder [/i]
